summary: Re-review completed statically; Laravel/PHP runtime remains unavailable, so authenticated API and browser flows could not run. The prior null-configuration score fix is present, but malformed saved weights are still unsafe.

critical.issue: Nested career_match is guarded, but malformed saved weights are merged without validating or coercing each required value. A value such as career_match.weights.skills='invalid' reaches arithmetic at line 99 and can produce a TypeError/500 instead of default scoring.

configuration['career_match']['weights'] is assigned without normalizing an existing null/scalar career_match value. A user with apply_configuration={"career_match":null} may receive an invalid nested offset warning/error during persistence.

action_items: Normalize career_match to an array before nested assignment in saveWeights().
Validate saved score weights as the five integer 0-100 fields (or discard malformed entries) before array_replace/arithmetic in score().
Run Laravel feature tests and responsive Playwright checks once PHP, Composer, database, and Vite are available.
critical_code_review_comments: The score endpoint still trusts persisted JSON configuration despite the requirement that null, empty, and malformed configurations fall back safely; persisted data must be treated as untrusted input.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Controller/config/view were re-reviewed. config/services.php now has deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash fallback and OPENROUTER_MODEL override. View data-testid values are unique. Runtime/auth/OpenRouter/responsive behavior still needs execution.
rca of the issue: score() only checks that the weights container is an array; it does not validate individual persisted values before numeric division. saveWeights() normalizes the top-level configuration but not the nested career_match node before assigning weights. PHP runtime and credentials file are unavailable in this container.
